page.overview:
Who is Calm man?

Calm man belongs to Avatar: The Last Airbender. When Avatar Aang, Katara, and Sokka first met this calm man, he was being attacked by a platypus bear.

The group saved him and inquired why he had not simply run away; he answered that Aunt Wu had predicted he would have a safe journey and that she had never been wrong. de:Ruhiger Mann es:Hombre calmado fr:Homme calme ru:Спокойный мужчина
